how_run: chat agents; each fresh agent read the complete supplied system_prompt.md verbatim as its labeling instructions, then the unchanged user_prompt_template.md filled with exactly one 25-paper batch. Prompts were loaded in agent task context rather than isolated API system/user messages.
notes: All 300 check papers were labeled from scratch with the unchanged v1 prompt supplied in package revision 2. No earlier v1 or v1.1 labels were reused or shown to labeling agents. Twelve fresh agents were launched with fork_turns=none, exactly one batch per agent, up to six concurrently. Agents were instructed to inspect only the supplied prompt and assigned titles/abstracts, without other batches' labels, reference labels, external lookup or an automated classifier. The coordinating agent merged all judgments unchanged and performed structural validation only. No model or reasoning-setting changes or post-merge label edits. Temperature is not exposed by collaboration tools and could not be set or verified, so its value is null. The supplied validation script was run before delivery. Step 2 has not been run; OUTPUT_SPEC.md requires an explicit go after this step-1 submission.
